verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only an OAuth 2.0 service-account API with operations such as auth, companyCaptable and companyTransactions, and never mentions an MCP server. A REST/GraphQL-style API is a developer building block for constructing an MCP server, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
